nodes.title: Read me
widgets_values:
MESH -> TEXTURED MESH -- Hunyuan3D 2.1 TexGen

mesh_path is a path INSIDE THE CONTAINER: /app/output/mesh/<name>.glb.
The image is the same concept the shape was generated from.

Run this as its own pass, after the shape.  3D-Pack pins its pipelines
outside ComfyUI's model management, so shape and texture in one queue
run each other out of VRAM on 16GB -- all the shapes, then restart,
then all the textures.

---

Texture an EXISTING mesh with Hunyuan3D 2.1 TexGen. Separate
from the shape pass on purpose: loading ShapeGen and TexGen in
one graph exceeds 16GB VRAM, and splitting also means a failed
texture never costs you the geometry, and that any generator's
mesh can be textured. mesh_path is a CONTAINER path. The
reference image should be the same concept the shape came from.
create_pbr writes albedo + metallic + roughness. LICENCE:
Tencent Hunyuan Community License excludes the EU, UK and South
Korea - see README.md#licensing. MEMORY: 6 views at 512 is what
fits. The graph shipped 8 at 768 while docs/guide/textures.md
listed 6/512 as the defaults, so anyone who ran it without
overrides OOM'd a 16GB card on a setting the documentation said
they already had. Raise max_num_view only in multiples of 30
degrees - the model indexes its camera embedding by azim // 30 -
and expect more views to cost time and to add more places for
two painted views to disagree.
